video_title: Spurs vs Hawks Preseason Postgame Press Conferences: Mitch Johnson, Victor Wembanyama & Dylan Harper

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on Steph Castle and Dylan Harper's offensive performance
quotes.excerpt: When we had pace and we had kick-aheads and moved the ball, we got good stuff.
quotes.quote: When we had pace and we had kick-aheads and moved the ball, we touched the paint early. When we didn't have an opportunity to because the defense was set and we changed sides, we got good stuff. And so again, just continuing to stay with that and growing and then obviously then when you get later in the clock, you got to continue to create advantages, but I thought they did a good job.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson on the Spurs offensive flow: When we had pace and moved the ball, we touched the paint early. We got good stuff.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on Dylan Harper's development and work ethic
quotes.excerpt: He's shown improvement since the start of his rookie year just in terms of the consistency.
quotes.quote: He's shown improvement since the start of his rookie year just in terms of the consistency of the mechanics or the percentages themselves. They're heading in the right direction and the young man has quite a bit of talent and he has a high-level work ethic. So I think he'll just be more about finding his spots and what are his shots and his opportunities in our offense and with the team and continue to have that pattern recognition where the game will just slow down for him.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson says Dylan Harper is showing consistent improvement in his mechanics and work ethic: The young man has quite a bit of talent.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on Victor Wembanyama's growth as an initiator
quotes.excerpt: He proposes a unique dilemma for a lot of teams when he plays with the ball.
quotes.quote: He proposes a unique dilemma for a lot of teams when he plays with the ball in his hands that high on the floor just because of the uniqueness of the action. And so he's gotten a lot better at seeing where his reads are and advantages are depending on how the defense guards him. And we've gotten better and need to be a lot better than we were at times tonight, but of spacing around him and playing off that where we should be able to have an advantage based on that if we're in the right spots.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson on Victor Wembanyama as an initiator: He proposes a unique dilemma for a lot of teams when he plays with the ball in his hands that high on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on Terrance Reed's rebounding ability
quotes.excerpt: He gets his hand on the basketball quite a bit and somehow seems like he's a magnet.
quotes.quote: He gets his hand on the basketball quite a bit and somehow seems like he's a magnet to contact in the best way. So he's a welcome addition to how he plays and some of the things he brings to the table.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson praises Terrance Reed for his rebounding: He gets his hand on the basketball quite a bit and somehow seems like he is a magnet to contact.

quotes.speaker: Mitch Johnson
quotes.summary_phrase: Mitch Johnson on the team's spacing and offensive ecosystem
quotes.excerpt: It's a delicate ecosystem. It's the Julians and the Devins and the Harrisons sprinting all the way.
quotes.quote: It's a delicate ecosystem. It's the Julians and the Devins and the Harrisons sprinting all the way to the corner to create gravity that way. It's Victor obviously in a variety of ways. And then it's the speed and the dynamic athleticism of the Fox and the Steph and the Dylan and so forth. And you know, there's guys that have a little bit of both like a Keldon. So we are well-equipped when we have the proper spacing and we pass the ball and we're greedy for the right shots to propose problems to the defense.
quotes.social_post: Mitch Johnson on the Spurs offensive ecosystem: We are well equipped when we have the proper spacing and we pass the ball and we are greedy for the right shots.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on team goals for the preseason
quotes.excerpt: First thing is shape, conditioning, and game-like conditions or regular season-like conditions.
quotes.quote: First thing is shape, conditioning, and game-like conditions or regular season-like conditions. Try some new stuff, get good habits, form new good habits, learn to play with each other for the ones who are new and increase that connection for the ones we've been playing together.
quotes.social_post: Victor Wembanyama on preseason goals: Try some new stuff, get good habits, form new good habits, learn to play with each other.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on Dylan Harper in the starting lineup
quotes.excerpt: It's not like we hadn't done it before. In practice, of course, we worked on it.
quotes.quote: It's not like we hadn't done it before. In practice, of course, we worked on it. Yeah, that worked out.
quotes.social_post: Victor Wembanyama on the new starting lineup featuring Dylan Harper: It is not like we had not done it before. In practice, of course, we worked on it.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on Devin Vassell's growth as a leader
quotes.excerpt: Devin's increasing leadership role coincides with our increased as a contender.
quotes.quote: Devin's increasing leadership role coincides with our increased as a contender. He embodies our progress and with Keldon, they are the oldest Spurs here. They know it. They know the power they got on this. They know how much they can make us better and they do it very well and very intelligently.
quotes.social_post: Victor Wembanyama on Devin Vassell: His increasing leadership role coincides with our increased as a contender. He embodies our progress.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on supporting student protesters in France
quotes.excerpt: I've had the chance to escape this system, you know, escape this trouble, but it's a chance.
quotes.quote: I've had the chance to escape this system, you know, escape this trouble, but it's a chance. It's lucky, you know. So I want to show my support.
quotes.social_post: Victor Wembanyama on why he supports student protesters in France: I have had the chance to escape this system, you know, escape this trouble, but it is a chance. I want to show my support.

quotes.speaker: Victor Wembanyama
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama on creating space for teammates
quotes.excerpt: It's a key of our offense. We got so much talent. We need to give the other guys.
quotes.quote: It's a key of our offense. We got so much talent. We need to give the other guys as much space and it's not too hard. The key is being ready to score because it's too easy to forget that you're also playing, but you need to be a threat in order to bring the defense with you.
quotes.social_post: Victor Wembanyama on his role as a playmaker: We have so much talent. We need to give the other guys as much space. The key is being ready to score.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on team chemistry and offensive execution
quotes.excerpt: Touching the paint is a big thing for me and Steph.
quotes.quote: Touching the paint is a big thing for me and Steph. Me and him feel like we're one of the most dynamic guards in the league. So just getting downhill and I feel like everything opens up even for Victor. Just having the knowledge and knowing when to cut, when not to cut, when to drive middle, when to drive slot, just little things like that. I feel like today we did good, but there's a lot better we can do.
quotes.social_post: Dylan Harper on his backcourt pairing with Steph Castle: Me and him feel like we are one of the most dynamic guards in the league. Just getting downhill and I feel like everything opens up.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on his improved shooting
quotes.excerpt: Shooting from the perimeter was a big thing for me and I think just getting more comfortable.
quotes.quote: Shooting from the perimeter was a big thing for me and I think just getting more comfortable with my shot. Get more comfortable shooting off the dribble and just try to be as efficient as I can. I feel like tonight the ball just went in.
quotes.social_post: Dylan Harper on his perimeter shooting: Shooting from the perimeter was a big thing for me and I think just getting more comfortable with my shot.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on playing with Victor Wembanyama and Steph Castle
quotes.excerpt: We're going to be really hard to guard.
quotes.quote: We're going to be really hard to guard. Like he said, when me and Steph get downhill, Victor has the same abilities. So I mean, I think all three of us is going to be hard to guard and there's going to be a whole lot of mismatches on the floor. And just playing with each other and we're all unselfish and we all understand where we're going to get our shots from, we understand what we all have to do to win. So I mean, it's going to be great.
quotes.social_post: Dylan Harper on playing with Wembanyama and Castle: We are going to be really hard to guard. All three of us is going to be hard to guard and there is going to be a whole lot of mismatches.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on Victor Wembanyama's playmaking
quotes.excerpt: Everything is slowing down more for him year by year.
quotes.quote: Everything is slowing down more for him year by year. And I feel like this year for him, we're all obviously going to help him with the playmaking part and make ourselves available and open, but he has the willingness. He has the will to playmake. He is a willing passer and every game we played in since training camp now, he's always found the right guy. He's always made the right play.
quotes.social_post: Dylan Harper on Wembanyama's growth: Everything is slowing down more for him year by year. He has the will to playmake. He is a willing passer.

quotes.speaker: Dylan Harper
quotes.summary_phrase: Dylan Harper on defensive focus for the three-guard lineup
quotes.excerpt: Rebounding is a big thing just in any lineup.
quotes.quote: Rebounding is a big thing just in any lineup. The only way we can get out and run is if we get stops and rebound. So defense, defense side of the ball for us is definitely probably a big emphasis and just getting stops and running.
quotes.social_post: Dylan Harper on the defensive focus for the three-guard lineup: The only way we can get out and run is if we get stops and rebound.
